meta.name: Esports Destiny Match scoring configuration
meta.note: Transparent, editable weights for the layered BaZi compatibility model. The local engine computes the ranking and percentages from these values. Nothing here is random.
meta.calibration: Day/month/year pillars, Li Chun zodiac boundary and lunar-mansion anchors are calibrated for a lightweight, entertainment-first experience — not for ephemeris-accurate BaZi.
meta.model_note: Each layer returns a 0..1 score; layer weights below sum to 1.0. If either side lacks a reliable birth hour, the birthHour weight is redistributed proportionally across the first three layers (never deducted).
